title: Harmonic Nodal Geometry, Zero-Curve Curvature, and the Transverse Integral Identity for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Mathematical note and reproducible verification package (15-page AMS-LaTeX PDF, 50-digit mpmath and rigorous mpmath.iv enclosure script, and AI-agent skill) analyzing universal harmonic nodal identities d|R|/ds = +/-|f'| along {I=0}, the two-mechanism dichotomy for off-critical zeros, the Csordas-Smith-Varga zero-curve curvature jet kappa(gamma_k) = Xi''(gamma_k)/Xi'(gamma_k), the canonical Transverse Integral Identity |Xi(t-i*d)|^2 = |Xi(t)|^2 + 2*int_0^d u*W_tilde(u,t) du with filter ratio tanh(d*y)/(d*y) in (0,1), and explicit Davenport-Heilbronn, Lehmer/Skewes, and Voronin obstructions.
notes: MSC 2020: Primary 11M06, 30C15; Secondary 30D15, 31A05, 65G30. Includes 15-page AMS-LaTeX PDF (paper/paper3_harmonic_nodal_chambers.pdf) and reproducible Python verification suite (scripts/verify_paper3_harmonic_nodal_chambers.py).
